title: Whip pan
summary: A winds up, whips out tilted and smeared under a light streak; B whips in, overshoots, its content trails.
signature: whipPan(a, b, p, { duration, dir, tilt, travel })

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

notes: A winds up, then whips out tilted and smeared; a light streak crosses at full speed; B whips in, overshoots and settles, its content trailing.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
when: you want speed with a light streak
